v.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
v.obj: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

v.name: The Scent of Lar'korwi
v.obj: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

v.name: A Sample of Slime...
v.obj: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

v.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
v.obj: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

v.name: Yuka Screwspigot
v.obj: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.

v.name: Kharan Mighthammer
v.obj:
Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.

The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

v.name: The Bearer of Bad News
v.obj: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

v.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
v.obj: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

v.name: The Corruption of the Jadefire
v.obj: Kill 11 Jadefire Felsworns, 9 Jadefire Shadowstalkers, 9 Jadefire Rogues, and Xavathras. Return to Eridan Bluewind in Felwood when the task has been completed.

v.name: Felbound Ancients
v.obj: Travel to Darnassus and use Eridan's Vial to collect a Vial of Blessed Water from the Temple of the Moon. Return to Eridan with the filled vial.

v.name: A Little Help From My Friends
Bungle in the Jungle
v.obj: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

v.name: Volcanic Activity
v.obj: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.

v.name: Super Sticky
v.obj: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

v.name: Well of Corruption
v.obj: Collect a sample of corrupted water from the Jadefire Satyrs' moonwell and bring it to Winna Hazzard at Bloodvenom Post.

v.name: Corrupted Sabers
v.obj:
Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moon well, release it, then bring it back to Winna.

Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

v.name: Pawn Captures Queen
v.obj:
Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.

Bring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

v.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
v.obj: Bring 6 Filled Cursed Ooze Jars and 6 Filled Tainted Ooze Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.

v.name: A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
Wild Guardians
v.obj: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.

v.name: Message to Freewind Post
v.obj: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.

v.name: Kayneth Stillwind
v.obj: Take Shindrell's Note to Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song.

v.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
v.obj: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

v.name: Washed Ashore
v.obj: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine.

v.name: Wild Guardians
v.obj: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.

v.name: Beached Sea Creature
v.obj: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

v.name: Beached Sea Turtle
v.obj: Take the Strangely Marked Box to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.

v.name: Broodling Essence
v.obj: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

v.name: WANTED: Murkdeep!
v.obj:
Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water.

Report the death of Murkdeep to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

v.name: Wild Guardians
v.obj: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.

v.name: Seal of Ascension
v.obj:
Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.

The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

v.name: Thundris Windweaver
v.obj: Speak with Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

v.name: The Cliffspring River
v.obj:
Travel north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there.

Return to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine with the Cliffspring River Sample.

v.name: The Blackwood Corrupted
v.obj:
Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.

Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.

Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.

Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

v.name: Wind Rider
v.obj: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.

v.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
The Ancient Egg
v.obj: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

v.name: The Final Tablets
v.obj: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

v.name: Chillwind Horns
v.obj: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

v.name: The Red Crystal
v.obj: Travel east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range.  Report back what you find to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

v.name: As Water Cascades
v.obj: Fill the Empty Water Tube at the Auberdine moonwell, and then investigate the red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain wall.

v.name: The Fragments Within
v.obj: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

v.name: Alien Egg
v.obj: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

v.name: Pacify the Centaur
v.obj: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

v.name: Enraged Wildkin
v.obj:
Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.

Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

v.name: Serpent Wild
v.obj: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

v.name: Assassination Plot
v.obj: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.

v.name: Guardians of the Altar
v.obj: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

v.name: Lost in Battle
v.obj: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

v.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
v.obj:
Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.

You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

v.name: Protect Kanati Greycloud
v.obj: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.

v.name: Operative Bijou
v.obj: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

v.name: Bijou's Belongings
v.obj: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

v.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
v.obj: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
v.obj: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Bijou's Belongings
v.obj: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

v.name: Message to Maxwell
v.obj: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.

v.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
v.obj: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

v.name: Pip Quickwit, At Your Service!
v.obj: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

objectives.d: Glowing Hunk of the Beast's Flesh

provided.name: Glowing Hunk of the Beast's Flesh

v.name: Good Natured Emma
v.obj: Find Ol' Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone.  If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.

v.name: The Jeremiah Blues
v.obj: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone.  If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

v.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
v.obj:
Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

v.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
v.obj: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

v.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
v.obj: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

v.name: Shy-Rotam
v.obj: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

v.name: Sacred Fire
v.obj: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

v.name: Grimtotem Spying
v.obj: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

v.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
v.obj: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

v.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
Threat of the Winterfall
v.obj: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

v.name: Falling to Corruption
v.obj: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

v.name: Mystery Goo
v.obj: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

v.name: Toxic Horrors
v.obj: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

v.name: Winterfall Runners
v.obj: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

v.name: Arikara
v.obj: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia Powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

v.name: General Drakkisath's Command
v.obj: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

v.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
Clear the Way
v.obj:
Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.

Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
Scarlet Diversions
v.obj:
Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.

Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: All Along the Watchtowers
v.obj:
Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.

Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: All Along the Watchtowers
v.obj:
Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.

Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Words of the High Chief
v.obj: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

v.name: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem
v.obj: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

v.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
v.obj: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

v.name: A Strange Historian
v.obj: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

v.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
v.obj: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

v.name: Forces of Jaedenar
v.obj: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

v.name: Verifying the Corruption
v.obj: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

v.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
v.obj: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

v.name: The Matron Protectorate
v.obj: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

v.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
v.obj: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

v.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
v.obj: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

v.name: Villains of Darrowshire
v.obj: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

v.name: A Strange Red Key
v.obj: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

v.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
v.obj: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

v.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
v.obj: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

v.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
v.obj: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

v.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
v.obj: Recover 20 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

v.name: Target: Felstone Field
v.obj: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there.  It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

v.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
v.obj: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

v.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
v.obj: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

v.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
v.obj: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

v.name: Target: Felstone Field
v.obj: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there.  It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

v.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
v.obj: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

v.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
v.obj: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

v.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
v.obj: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

v.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
v.obj: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.

v.name: Fragments of the Past
v.obj: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

v.name: The Archivist
v.obj: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

v.name: Eagan Peltskinner
v.obj: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

v.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
v.obj: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

v.name: Above and Beyond
v.obj: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

v.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
v.obj: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

v.name: The Restless Souls
v.obj: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

v.name: The Sleeper Has Awakened
v.obj: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver south along the road to find his bag in Darkshore.

v.name: Barov Family Fortune
v.obj: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

v.name: Barov Family Fortune
v.obj: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

v.name: Family Tree
v.obj: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

v.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
v.obj: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

v.name: Catch of the Day
v.obj: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

v.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
v.obj: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

v.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
v.obj: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

v.name: Menethil's Gift
v.obj: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

v.name: Menethil's Gift
v.obj: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

v.name: Soulbound Keepsake
v.obj: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

v.name: Gordo's Task
v.obj: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

v.name: Doom Weed
v.obj: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

v.name: Bone Collector
v.obj: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.

v.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
v.obj: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

v.name: A Reliquary of Purity
v.obj: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village.  If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

v.name: Plagued Hatchlings
v.obj: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

v.name: Kim'jael's "Missing" Equipment
v.obj: Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.

v.name: Skeletal Fragments
v.obj: Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Ammo for Rumbleshot
v.obj: Bring Rumbleshot's Ammo to Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh.

v.name: Demon Dogs
v.obj: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

v.name: Blood Tinged Skies
v.obj: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

v.name: Carrion Grubbage
v.obj: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

v.name: A Bundle of Trouble
v.obj: Bring 8 Bundles of Wood to Raelen at the Eastvale Logging Camp.

v.name: Kodo Roundup
v.obj: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.

v.name: Portals of the Legion
v.obj: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.

v.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
v.obj: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.

v.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
v.obj: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

v.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
v.obj: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

v.name: The Power to Destroy...
v.obj: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.

v.name: Hidden Enemies
v.obj: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Hidden Enemies
v.obj: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Hidden Enemies
v.obj: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Hidden Enemies
v.obj: Speak to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Hidden Enemies
v.obj: Speak to Thrall in Orgrimmar and tell him what you've learned.

v.name: Sceptre of Light
v.obj: Get the Sceptre of Light and then return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

v.name: Slaying the Beast
v.obj: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Hemet Nesingwary
v.obj: Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

v.name: Hunting in Stranglethorn
v.obj: Bring Roon's Kodo Horn to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

v.name: Of Forgotten Memories
v.obj: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

v.name: Fire Plume Forged
v.obj:
Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.

Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Fire Plume Forged
v.obj:
Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.

Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Araj's Scarab
v.obj: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Araj's Scarab
v.obj: Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Of Lost Honor
v.obj: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

v.name: Of Love and Family
v.obj: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

v.name: Of Love and Family
v.obj:
Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.

Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.

v.name: Find Myranda
v.obj: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

v.name: Scarlet Subterfuge
v.obj:
Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.

Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.

v.name: The Dunemaul Compound
v.obj: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

v.name: Calling in the Reserves
v.obj: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.

v.name: A Plague Upon Thee
v.obj: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

v.name: A Plague Upon Thee
v.obj: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

v.name: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
Unfinished Business
v.obj: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
v.obj: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

v.name: To Kill With Purpose
v.obj: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

v.name: Unfinished Business
v.obj: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Unfinished Business
v.obj: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

v.name: That's Asking A Lot
v.obj:
Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.

You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

v.name: Book of the Ancients
v.obj: Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

v.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
Un-Life's Little Annoyances
v.obj: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

v.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
v.obj:
Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.

You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

v.name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
v.obj: Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.

v.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
Brother Anton
v.obj: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace.

v.name: Clam Bait
v.obj: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.

v.name: The Crimson Courier
v.obj:
Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.

Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

v.name: Nathanos' Ruse
v.obj: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

v.name: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!
v.obj: Find Rackmore's Silver Key.  Find Rackmore's Golden Key.  Find and open Rackmore's Chest.

v.name: A Husband's Last Battle
v.obj: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

v.name: A Swift Message
v.obj: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.

v.name: Flint Shadowmore
v.obj: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.

v.name: The Eastern Plagues
v.obj: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

v.name: The Blightcaller Cometh
v.obj: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

v.name: Dungar Longdrink
v.obj: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

v.name: Continue to Stormwind
v.obj: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

v.name: Harpies Threaten
v.obj: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

v.name: Bloodfury Bloodline
v.obj: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

v.name: Arachnophobia
v.obj: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

v.name: Return to Lewis
v.obj: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.

v.name: Cycle of Rebirth
v.obj: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

v.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
v.obj: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.

v.name: Ride to the Undercity
v.obj: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

v.name: Return to Podrig
v.obj: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

v.name: Meats to Orgrimmar
v.obj: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

v.name: New Life
v.obj: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

v.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
v.obj: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

v.name: Ride to Orgrimmar
v.obj: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Doras the Wind Rider Master
v.obj: Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Return to the Crossroads
v.obj: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

v.name: Honor Students
v.obj: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

v.name: Gryth Thurden
v.obj: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

v.name: A Plague Upon Thee
v.obj: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

v.name: A Plague Upon Thee
v.obj: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

v.name: Ride to Ironforge
v.obj: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

v.name: Return to Brock
v.obj: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

v.name: Elemental War
v.obj: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

v.name: Kaya's Alive
v.obj: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

v.name: The Great Masquerade
v.obj:
Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

Speak to Squire Rowe if you need to contact Reginald Windsor again.

v.name: Boulderslide Ravine
v.obj: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

v.name: Satyr Horns
v.obj: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

v.name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
v.obj: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

v.name: Blood Feeders
v.obj: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

v.name: Troll Charm
v.obj: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

v.name: Earthen Arise
v.obj: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

v.name: Freedom to Ruul
v.obj: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Spintertree Post.

v.name: The Dragon's Eye
v.obj: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

v.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
v.obj: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

v.name: The Lost Pages
v.obj: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

v.name: An Unholy Alliance
v.obj: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

v.name: An Unholy Alliance
v.obj: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

v.name: Protect Kaya
v.obj: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

v.name: Report to Kadrak
v.obj: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

v.name: Report to Kadrak
v.obj: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

v.name: The Warsong Reports
v.obj: Open the Bundle of Reports.  Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

v.name: Torek's Assault
v.obj: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

v.name: Avenge My Village
v.obj: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

v.name: Blackfathom Villainy
v.obj: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

v.name: Trouble in the Deeps
v.obj: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

v.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
v.obj: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

v.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
v.obj: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

v.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
v.obj: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

v.name: The Testament of Rexxar
v.obj: Deliver Rexxar's Testament to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

v.name: Oculus Illusions
v.obj: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

v.name: Emberstrife
v.obj: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

v.name: Warsong Supplies
v.obj: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

v.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
Clamlette Surprise
v.obj:
Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:

12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.

10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!

20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!

Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

v.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
v.obj: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

v.name: King of the Foulweald
v.obj: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound.  Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner.  Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.

v.name: Triage
v.obj:
Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

v.name: Horde Trauma
v.obj: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Doctor Gregory Victor about joining the ranks of Horde Trauma.

v.name: A Host of Evil
v.obj: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

v.name: Test of Lore
v.obj: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

v.name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
v.obj: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

v.name: Vorsha the Lasher
v.obj:
Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.

If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.

v.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Dark Iron Ore
Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core
Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core
Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather
Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Blood of the Mountain
Deeprun Rat Roundup
v.obj: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.

v.name: Me Brother, Nipsy
v.obj: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.

v.name: Amongst the Ruins
v.obj: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

v.name: Baron Aquanis
v.obj: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

v.name: The Glowing Shard
v.obj:
Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.

Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

v.name: Zapped Giants
v.obj: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

v.name: Twisted Evils
v.obj: Collect 25 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

v.name: Vyletongue Corruption
v.obj:
Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.

Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.

Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

v.name: Legends of Maraudon
v.obj:
Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.

Find a way to speak with Celebras.

v.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
v.obj: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

v.name: Seed of Life
v.obj: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

v.name: The Pariah's Instructions
v.obj: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

v.name: Shadowshard Fragments
v.obj: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
v.obj: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

v.name: Crown of the Earth
v.obj: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.

v.name: The Madness Within
v.obj:
You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.

Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.

Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

v.name: Arcane Refreshment
v.obj: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

v.name: Elven Legends
v.obj: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.

v.name: Elven Legends
v.obj: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

v.name: Attunement to the Core
v.obj: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.

v.name: Victory for the Horde
v.obj: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Victory for the Alliance
v.obj: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

v.name: Garona: A Study on Stealth and Treachery

starts.name: Garona: A Study on Stealth and Treachery

v.name: The Light and How To Swing It

starts.name: The Light and How to Swing It

v.name: Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You

starts.name: Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You

v.name: Nostro's Compendium
v.obj: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

starts.name: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade

v.name: The Prison's Bindings
v.obj: Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.

v.name: Imp Delivery
v.obj: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance.  After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

v.name: Material Assistance
v.obj: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

v.name: Look at the Size of It!
Fuel for the Zapping
v.obj: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

v.name: What the Flux?
v.obj: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

v.name: Again With the Zapped Giants
v.obj: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form.  Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

v.name: Refuel for the Zapping
v.obj: Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

v.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
v.obj: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

v.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
v.obj: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

v.name: Stinglasher
v.obj: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

v.name: Zukk'ash Report
v.obj: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore.  He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

v.name: Improved Quality
v.obj: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

v.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood
Perfect Yeti Hide
v.obj: Bring the Perfect Yeti Hide to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

v.name: Blackhand's Command
v.obj:
That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.

The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.

v.name: The Lord of Blackrock
v.obj: Return the Head of Nefarian to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

v.name: The Lord of Blackrock
v.obj: Return the Head of Nefarian to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

v.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
v.obj: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

v.name: Gammerita, Mon!
v.obj:
Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.

Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

v.name: Stalking the Stalkers
v.obj:
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Silvermane Stalkers and 15 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.

Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

v.name: Hunt the Savages
v.obj:
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.

Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

v.name: Avenging the Fallen
v.obj:
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.

Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

v.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
v.obj:
Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.

You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

v.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
v.obj:
Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.

Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

v.name: Message to the Wildhammer
v.obj:
Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.

You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

v.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
v.obj:
Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.

Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

v.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
Cannibalistic Cousins
v.obj:
Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.

Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

v.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
v.obj:
Primal Torntusk at Raventusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.

You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

v.name: Recover the Key!
v.obj: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torn'tusk when you have recovered the key.

v.name: WANTED: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
v.obj:
You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.

Vile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

v.name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
v.obj:
You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.

Should you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

v.name: The Darkmoon Faire
v.obj: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival.

v.name: The Hand of Rastakhan
v.obj: Speak with Molthor in Stranglethorn.

v.name: Rare Fish - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer
Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Iron
